The spine is a separation the donor made but never stated as the point: a RUN is a property of the win rate alone -- the payoff never enters the calculation -- while a DRAWDOWN needs both p and b, because how far you fall depends on what the winners scattered through the fall give back. The expected WAITING TIME for a run, (1 - q^k) / (p * q^k), which turns 'will it happen' into 'how often': at a 45% win rate the first run of eight arrives every 263 trades, about fifteen months at four a week, so a decade of that system should contain about eight of them. And the percentage columns are computed by compounding rather than by multiplication: a 16R drawdown at 1% risk a trade is a fall of 14.8%, not 16%, and at 3% it is 38.1%, not 48%.
